title: Obsolescence Forecasting and Data Augmentation Using Deep Generative Models
summary: A research codebase comparing deep generative models (CTGAN, TVAE, normalizing flows) for synthetic data generation and augmentation, evaluated via statistical similarity and discriminator-based detection tests. It uses SDV's CTGANSynthesizer and TVAESynthesizer to fit and sample synthetic tabular data, and SDMetrics detection/statistical metrics to evaluate the generated outputs.
